reason: The cited lines show authenticated access to Azure DevOps-style APIs using a bearer token and reading work item/wiki data into variables, so SECRET is supported. They also show API-derived/user-content-like relation data being returned in tool output via JSON.stringify(relations), so UNTRUSTED is supported. There is no arbitrary host code execution shown, so HOSTEXEC is not supported. The fetch sends a request to connection.serverUrl with an Authorization header, but these lines alone do not establish that the destination is agent-chosen or attacker-readable rather than a fixed service endpoint, so SINK is insufficient.
